analysis: The trial succeeded operationally. Pinned-host validation macro HR@10 was 0.6162, improving by 0.0049 over the supplied parent score of 0.6113 but remaining 0.0113 below the supplied best of 0.6275. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.650, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.675, Electronics 0.450, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.690. Electronics had the lowest absolute performance; category-level improvements cannot be established without parent category scores. Candidate-conditioned history retrieval is promising relative to the parent, but this result does not establish superiority over the best supplied configuration. Allocated GPU time was 1295.18 seconds. No test results were available.
code_summary: Trains exactly one jointly optimized graph network per category and loads one selected checkpoint for each route. Retains learned graph-depth attention, supervised-edge masking, residual causal history convolution, recent-event queries, sampled-softmax loss, and tied item vectors with learned item bias. Adds a zero-initialized candidate-query projection that produces candidate-specific history attention, summaries, and fusion gates; empty histories preserve the graph-user representation. Training checkpoints bounded candidate chunks while keeping one softmax over all candidates. Predictor reconstruction, architecture metadata, and strict checkpoint loading include the new projection. RNG-preserving diagnostics cover initialization equivalence, gradients, finite padded/empty outputs, chunk parity, and serialization parity. No independent auxiliary scorer or ensemble is used.
